verdict.rationale: three.js ships an editor (threejs-docs-7), so the editor-extensibility axis applies. However, the evidence only names the editor and gives no documentation of plugins, editor scripts, custom tool registration, or programmatic scene or asset manipulation within it. Library primitives such as TransformControls are developer building blocks, not editor extensibility, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can extend and automate the editor itself — custom tools, editor scripts, plugins that manipulate scenes and assets programmatically
